purpose: Keep the learned RS result and repair the MS supervision unit so the public author relation and the runtime resource are both session-level.

claim.primary: A low-capacity auditable PM can conditionally open RS and a strictly-past session memory whose source is supported by public author annotations, while failed heads remain OFF and final quality, risk, function, and cost are measured independently.
not_claimed: annotation suitability guarantees generator use or quality gain

action_space.projection: qualified RS/MS probabilities followed by deterministic eligibility, conflict, risk, and cost projection

MS.unit: one current-session checkpoint plus one frozen actual Rank-1 prior-session resource
MS.checkpoint: first current seeker turn where cumulative visible seeker text reaches at least 50 whitespace-delimited words
MS.pre_checkpoint_behavior: MS hard OFF because the current session has insufficient bounded target evidence
MS.candidate: all nonempty seeker turns from one completed strictly-past session, in raw order, with exact text and speaker boundaries
MS.rank1: frozen BGE-M3 cosine between the complete visible current-session prefix and each eligible prior-session resource
MS.positive: actual Rank-1 source_session_id belongs to the recursive strict-past ancestor-session set in EvoEmo event_experience.influenced_by
MS.negative: actual Rank-1 exists but its source_session_id is not in that set

learning.split: six frozen connected-owner outer folds; p13 and p18 remain bound
learning.classifier: StandardScaler plus L2 logistic regression C=0.10, class_weight=balanced, liblinear, seed=20260810
learning.uncertainty: report pooled OOF, equal-owner macro metrics, and owner-cluster bootstrap; do not treat sessions as independent users

physical_separation.public_runtime_artifacts: checkpoint states, exact raw prior-session resources, actual Rank-1 and runtime features; label fields null

no_loop_rules: Do not change the 50-word checkpoint after label or fit results.
Do not change the author-ancestry label.
Do not change features, classifier, threshold, or gates after the V2 capacity audit.
Do not add synthetic users, human/LLM labels, encoder challengers, or rescue packets.
Allow exactly one V2 grouped OOF if the pre-fit audit passes; otherwise stop.
